dispositions.topic_text: Whether no-write replay or failed-delivery paths may create locks or folders
Placement and mark record addresses and filenames
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): the address of each record and of the lock file, composed from LOCKS_FOLDER, PLACEMENTS_FOLDER, MARKS_FOLDER, LOCK_FILE_SUFFIX, RECORD_FILE_SUFFIX, the canonical project UUID and the source id.

dispositions.topic_text: Project lock address derivation and collision-free filename
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): the address of each record and of the lock file, composed from LOCKS_FOLDER, PLACEMENTS_FOLDER, MARKS_FOLDER, LOCK_FILE_SUFFIX, RECORD_FILE_SUFFIX, the canonical project UUID and the source id.

dispositions.topic_text: Temporary-file naming, exclusive creation, collision, replacement, and cleanup rules
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): temporary names: fresh, created exclusively with TEMPORARY_FILE_MODE, a taken name passed over, removed after a failed write.

dispositions.topic_text: Missing-folder creation order, races, collisions, modes, and failures
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): folders below the roots made to exist outermost first; a folder found is accepted; a link or non-folder fails the write; for a stored image each created folder synchronised in its parent before the next.

dispositions.topic_text: Atomic replacement visibility for an existing destination file
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): atomic replacement by rename over the destination, so an existing file is never absent to a reader.

dispositions.topic_text: Required record file type and symbolic-link handling
dispositions.what: delivery_store note (State 7): a record is opened without following a link and must be a regular file; anything else is state_unavailable.

dispositions.topic_text: Accepted EXIF date-time byte and text grammar
dispositions.what: photo_preparation note (State 7): the accepted EXIF date-time text, YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS with trailing NUL or spaces removed; anything else is malformed.

dispositions.topic_text: Accepted time-zone identifiers, database version, and invalid-value behavior
dispositions.what: the deployment image pins the time zone database (tzdata) with the libraries of A9; the timezone setting accepts the keys that database knows.

dispositions.reason: Only the service creates the lock file and never changes it (A6 rule 4); no text admits another mode, owner or content.

dispositions.topic_text: Classification of missing record ancestors versus inaccessible state
dispositions.reason: The installation creates the state folder and the service never removes it (A6 rule 2); no text admits its disappearance, and an unreadable state is state_unavailable.
